query_text: Where can I get tickets for the next NBA game?

request_params.system_prompt: You have a web search tool. message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to get tickets for the next NBA game:

## Official Sources (Recommended)

**1. Ticketmaster**
Ticketmaster is the **Official Ticketing Partner of the NBA**. You can browse and purchase tickets for every NBA game directly at:
- https://www.ticketmaster.com/nba

**2. NBA Official Ticket Portal**
The NBA's official ticket website redirects you to official suppliers:
- https://nbatickets.nba.com/

**3. Team-Specific Official Sites**
Most NBA teams sell tickets through their official websites, which typically partner with Ticketmaster or AXS.

## Alternative Resale Marketplaces

If tickets are sold out on official channels, these verified resale platforms offer guaranteed authentic tickets:

| Platform | Website |
|----------|---------|
| StubHub | https://www.stubhub.com/nba-tickets/grouping/115 |
| Vivid Seats | https://www.vividseats.com/nba-basketball |
| SeatGeek | seatgeek.com |
| AXS | axs.com (for select teams like Timberwolves and Rockets) |

## Tips for Buying NBA Tickets

- **Best time to buy**: August or early September when single-game tickets typically go on sale
- **Average ticket price**: $100-$200 for regular season games (varies by matchup, seat location, and city)
- **Mobile tickets**: Most platforms now offer digital tickets via their apps or mobile wallets
- **If you can't attend**: You can resell tickets on official platforms like Ticketmaster's resale marketplace

## For International Games

For special NBA events outside the U.S. (like NBA Paris Games or NBA London/Berlin Games):
- Pre-register at the official NBA event pages
- AXS typically handles ticketing for European games

---

**Sources:**
1. https://www.ticketmaster.com/nba
2. https://nbatickets.nba.com/
3. https://www.vividseats.com/nba-basketball
4. https://www.stubhub.com/nba-tickets/grouping/115
5. https://www.nbamaniacs.com/en/news/how-to-buy-nba-tickets/
6. https://www.ticketsmarter.com/p/nba-western-conference-finals-tickets
7. https://www.viagogo.com/cn/Sports-Tickets/Basketball/NBA
8. https://www.talkbasket.net/187566-nba-paris-games-2025-ticket-sales-begin-october-24
9. https://nbaevents.nba.com/berlin/en/tickets/faqs
